summary: Wired the Repository Transition Validator's TransitionKind.NOTIFY and notification_eligible() (frozen since 113T/113U, never previously called from a real dispatch path) into pcae phase complete and pcae task finish --commit. Added src/pcae/core/notification_certification.py with certify_notification_transition(...) and notification_transport_status() as the single notification authority both callers now consume, replacing two independently-shaped ad hoc idempotency checks built directly on the Phase 113V.N marker file. NotificationCertificationOutcome names exactly one of eligible, already_dispatched, disabled, transport_unavailable, or not_certified per attempt. Idempotency mechanism is unchanged (the marker file, written only after a successful dispatch); a failed dispatch never writes it, so retries remain deterministic and safe. Notification failure never invalidates canonical repository state -- latest.md/latest.json are written before dispatch is attempted regardless of outcome. Successful Telegram/filesystem dispatch behavior remains byte-for-byte compatible. No changes to TelegramSink, dispatch(), sink construction, push-check integration, Runtime Snapshot, Runtime Inspect, Permission Broker, REST, Telegram inbound, or execution integration were made. Execution capability remains unavailable.
